answer: A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the shale graph. Re-attestations are stored in velvet and signal lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 5 epochs, which means holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 2686 identities would post 4778 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
